name: feedback-replay-v1
description: Authored subjects for replaying recorded feedback into ranking. Each subject has one passage that answers it, one near miss on the same subject, two ways of asking it that feedback is recorded from, and a paraphrase that is only ever evaluated. Sixteen subjects come in sibling pairs that share wording (two rate tiers, two storage quotas, two clinics...), so a passage judged useful for one is a close candidate for the other; eight stand alone. Halves alternate, so every sibling pair has one subject in each half; the halves were declared before any measurement, and the replay runs twice, judging each half once. Measures the mechanism on a small corpus, not a real-world rate.
